title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV conversation roughly doubled week on week, led by a report of 16 infant infections within 20 days at a Changhua Christian Hospital-linked postpartum care home (RSV tagged, pathogen not confirmed in the report) and a pregnant poster who paid out of pocket for a maternal RSV vaccine. Nothing this week names nirsevimab or infant antibodies directly.
products.implication: Postpartum care homes and newborn protection are becoming a visible issue, which may prompt questions from regulators, care-home operators and parents about infant RSV prevention options and who pays.
products.action: Prepare a factual evidence pack on infant RSV burden and prevention options for medical-information use; map postpartum care home and neonatal stakeholders; hold reactive lines ready in case the cluster pathogen is confirmed as RSV.
products.signal_zh: RSV討論較前一週約增加一倍，主因為一則報導指彰化基督教醫院相關產後護理之家20天內16名嬰兒感染（標註RSV，但報導未確認病原），以及一名孕婦發文提及自費接種孕婦RSV疫苗。本週無任何內容直接提及nirsevimab或嬰兒抗體。
products.implication_zh: 產後護理之家與新生兒保護正成為顯著議題，可能引發主管機關、護理之家業者及家長對嬰兒RSV預防選項及費用負擔的疑問。
products.action_zh: 準備嬰兒RSV疾病負擔與預防選項的實證資料包，供醫藥資訊使用；盤點產後護理之家及新生兒相關利害關係人；備妥回應口徑，以因應群聚病原確認為RSV的情況。
who_zh: 產後護理機構相關公會

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.signal: Doctors quoted by Rti and Life link flu in older adults to stroke, cardiovascular and disability risk and urge consideration of adjuvanted or high-dose vaccines; one broadcast report describes these types as offering stronger protection. Several top-up stories mention enhanced vaccines, but none states whether the extra doses include them. High-dose volume fell (11 vs 18).
products.implication: Clinician-led framing keeps enhanced flu in the news, but product-type comparisons in public media could draw advertising-rule scrutiny, and unclear top-up composition may generate eligibility questions from facilities.
products.action: Keep engagement scientific: brief geriatric and cardiology societies with peer-reviewed evidence on request, confirm with Taiwan CDC how enhanced doses are allocated within the top-up, and ensure company spokespeople avoid product claims in media.
who: Taiwan Association of Gerontology and Geriatrics
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），核准用於65歲以上
products.signal_zh: 央廣及Life引述醫師指出，長者感染流感與中風、心血管及失能風險相關，呼籲考慮佐劑型或高劑量疫苗；一則廣電報導描述這類疫苗保護力較強。數則追加採購報導提及加強型疫苗，但均未說明追加劑數是否包含在內。高劑量聲量下滑（11對18）。
products.implication_zh: 以臨床醫師為主的論述讓加強型流感疫苗持續見報，但在大眾媒體比較產品類型可能引來廣告法規審視，且追加採購組成不明，可能引發醫療院所對接種資格的疑問。
products.action_zh: 維持科學性溝通：應要求向老年醫學及心臟學會簡報同儕審查實證，向疾管署確認追加採購中加強型疫苗的分配方式，並確保公司發言人在媒體上避免產品宣稱。
who_zh: 台灣老年學暨老年醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.sub: pertussis booster for adolescents, adults and pregnancy
products.signal: Little this week: Tdap mentions are low (7 vs 5) and no top story names Tdap. The nearest item is a parent survey finding nearly 40% had not kept children on the routine schedule beyond flu and COVID-19, with calls for vaccine leave and child vaccine vouchers; it does not name Tdap.
products.implication: No live Tdap issue, but voucher and routine-schedule proposals could open a policy window for broader immunisation funding discussions.
products.action: Monitor voucher proposals and track whether advocacy groups include adolescent, adult or maternal boosters; keep a background brief on pertussis burden ready for policy stakeholders.
who: Parent advocacy groups behind the survey
products.sub_zh: 適用於青少年、成人及孕婦的百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 本週資訊甚少：Tdap提及數低（7對5），且無主要報導提及Tdap。最相關的是一項家長調查，發現近40%未讓孩子按時程接種流感及COVID-19以外的常規疫苗，並呼籲設立疫苗假及兒童疫苗券；該調查未提及Tdap。
products.implication_zh: 目前無Tdap相關熱點議題，但疫苗券及常規時程提案可能為更廣泛的預防接種經費討論開啟政策窗口。
products.action_zh: 監測疫苗券提案，追蹤倡議團體是否納入青少年、成人或孕婦追加劑；備妥百日咳疾病負擔背景資料，供政策利害關係人參考。
who_zh: 發起調查的家長倡議團體
立法院衛環委員會委員

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Taiwan CDC announced on 13 October that Novavax, described as a vaccine of a different manufacturing process, joins the public COVID-19 programme from 19 October and that additional Novavax doses are planned; dozens of outlets relayed the start date.
products.implication: Launch week will bring scrutiny of site-level availability, booking and early-reaction posts in the public programme; brand-agnostic COVID-19 misinformation circulating online could attach to the new option.
products.action: Coordinate with Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus on distribution timing and contracted-site lists, prepare a factual backgrounder for media questions, and confirm adverse-event monitoring and medical-information channels are ready for 19 October.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單元疫苗，由Sanofi經銷
products.signal_zh: 疾管署10月13日宣布，被描述為不同製程疫苗的Novavax自10月19日起納入公費COVID-19疫苗計畫，並規劃增購Novavax疫苗；數十家媒體轉述開打日期。
products.implication_zh: 開打週將出現對公費計畫中站點供應、預約及初期反應貼文的檢視；網路上流傳的不分品牌COVID-19不實資訊可能延燒至此新選項。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署及地方衛生局協調配送時程與合約院所名單，準備因應媒體提問的事實背景資料，並確認不良事件監測及醫藥資訊管道於10月19日前就緒。
who_zh: 中華民國醫師公會全國聯合會

issues.title: Novavax public COVID-19 rollout begins
issues.note: Expect questions on which sites stock Novavax and posts about first-dose experiences; have availability and safety-monitoring lines ready.
issues.note_zh: 預期出現哪些站點提供Novavax的詢問及首劑接種經驗貼文；備妥供應情形及安全監測回應口徑。

issues.title: Stock gaps before top-up doses arrive and second stage opens
issues.note: Reports describe shortage fears and a rush to vaccinate, with 474,000 extra doses expected in early November and the second stage opening on 2 November.
issues.title_zh: 追加疫苗到貨及第二階段開打前的庫存缺口
issues.note_zh: 報導指民眾擔心缺貨而搶打疫苗，47.4萬劑追加疫苗預計11月初到貨，第二階段於11月2日開打。

issues.title: Infant infection cluster puts postpartum care homes in spotlight
issues.note: If the Changhua cluster is confirmed as RSV, expect calls on newborn protection and care-home infection control; prepare evidence and stakeholder map.
issues.title_zh: 嬰兒群聚感染使產後護理之家成為焦點
issues.note_zh: 若彰化群聚確認為RSV，預期將出現新生兒保護及護理之家感染管制的呼聲；備妥實證資料與利害關係人盤點。

self_pay.title: Self-pay COVID-19 cost burden raised
self_pay.note: A Rotary club says self-paid vaccination is a heavy cost burden and calls for subsidies for vulnerable older adults; the report does not name a brand.
self_pay.title_zh: 自費COVID-19疫苗費用負擔受關注
self_pay.note_zh: 某扶輪社表示自費接種費用負擔沉重，呼籲補助弱勢長者；報導未提及品牌。

self_pay.title: Maternal RSV paid out of pocket
self_pay.note: One pregnant poster reports paying for an RSV vaccine and being told the price would be higher after birth; a single post, and nothing this week on clinic stock or prices for infant RSV antibodies.
self_pay.note_zh: 一名孕婦發文表示自費接種RSV疫苗，並被告知產後價格會更高；僅此一則貼文，本週無診所嬰兒RSV抗體庫存或價格相關資訊。

self_pay.title: Little visibility on self-pay stock for enhanced flu or Tdap
self_pay.note: A few top-up reports mention both public and self-pay options and one notes shortage fears, but none gives self-pay stock, prices or demand for high-dose, adjuvanted flu or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感或Tdap自費庫存資訊有限
self_pay.note_zh: 少數追加採購報導同時提及公費與自費選項，其中一則提到缺貨憂慮，但均未提供高劑量、佐劑型流感疫苗或Tdap的自費庫存、價格或需求資訊。
